data_availability.bilbao_proxy_issue: The local shell proxy had to be bypassed by disabling trust_env and seeding the turnstile_passed cookie.
data_availability.single_route_comment: Ordinary SG 194 required Bilbao SITESYM rather than DSITESYM because the target is the ordinary single-valued SG 194 standard AI.
data_availability.double_route_comment: BANDREP Wyckoff pages were sufficient to enumerate Bilbao's physically irreducible double-space-group band representations site by site.

main_route.single: Bilbao ordinary SITESYM site-symmetry induced representations at GM, A, K, H, M, L.
main_route.double: Bilbao BANDREP Wyckoff pages without TR, parsed one Wyckoff position at a time.

blockers.single: No external-data blocker remained after ordinary SITESYM access was stabilized.
blockers.double: Bilbao labels physically irreducible double-space-group generators in a convention that does not match the current 45-label local-corep library one-to-one, especially at 2b/2c/2d and 6h.
